user.title: Connect App Store Connect
user.description:
Home Assistant needs an App Store Connect API key to read App Units and build versions.

In App Store Connect, open **Users and Access › Integrations › Keys** ({keys_url}), create a key with access to **App Manager** (or **Admin**) plus **Sales and Trends**, then paste the Key ID, Issuer ID and the contents of the `.p8` file below.

The vendor number is under **Agreements, Tax, and Banking**. This integration only ever *reads* sales reports and build metadata.

data_description.key_id: The 10-character Key ID shown next to the key in App Store Connect.
data_description.issuer_id: The Issuer ID at the top of the Keys page.
data_description.private_key: Paste the full PEM text of the AuthKey_XXXXXXXXXX.p8 file, including the BEGIN and END lines.
data_description.vendor_number: Numeric vendor number from Agreements, Tax, and Banking. The studio default is 93606071.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect App Store Connect
reauth_confirm.description:
App Store Connect is no longer accepting the stored API key. This usually means the key was revoked or a new .p8 was generated.

Create a new key under **Users and Access › Integrations › Keys** ({keys_url}) and paste it below. Your existing sensors and their recorded history are kept.

data_description.key_id: Must belong to the same App Store Connect team as before.
data_description.issuer_id: The Issuer ID at the top of the Keys page.
data_description.private_key: Paste the full PEM text of the new .p8 file.

error.invalid_auth: App Store Connect rejected that API key. Check the Key ID, Issuer ID and that the .p8 belongs to this key.
error.invalid_key: That private key is not a valid ES256 .p8 PEM. Paste the whole file, including the BEGIN and END lines.
error.invalid_vendor: Enter the numeric vendor number from Agreements, Tax, and Banking.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach App Store Connect. Check this machine's internet connection and try again.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. The Home Assistant log has the details.

abort.already_configured: This App Store Connect vendor has already been added.

init.title: App Store Connect options
init.description: How often to refresh App Units and build versions.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to ask App Store Connect for new data. Daily sales reports only land once a day, so checking more often than every few hours rarely shows you anything new.
